rows.commentary: 0.1: Taskin Ahmed starts his spell angling a length delivery in on off, and Brandon King calmly eases it toward the covers.
0.2: Taskin hits a back-of-a-length spot on off that stays slightly low, prompting King to hang back and guide it toward mid-on.
0.3: Taskin oversteps as he hurls a fuller delivery outside off that swings away, drawing an outside edge from King toward point as he reaches for the drive.
0.3: Taskin bowls a peach in the corridor of uncertainty, angling it in before it seams away to open up King's stance and beat him on the outside edge.
0.4: Taskin targets a length outside off with sharp inward swing, forcing King to lean forward and block off the inner half toward mid-wicket.
0.5: Taskin angles a back-of-a-length delivery in from outside off that beats King across the line and strikes him high on the pads, prompting an appeal that Shanto declines to review.
0.6: Taskin delivers a sensational jaffa outside off that swings in sharply with extra bounce, beating King's drive on the inside edge to narrowly miss the off-stump.
1.1: Hasan Mahmud drops a good length delivery into the channel that shapes away, allowing Joshua Da Silva to softly tap it toward point.
1.2: Hasan brings this fuller length delivery shaping in on off, and Joshua Da Silva cleanly flicks it in the direction of mid-on.
1.3: Hasan probes on a length, keeping Joshua Da Silva completely locked down at the crease.
1.4: Joshua Da Silva does not score off Hasan Mahmud.
10.3: Taskin Ahmed angles a fuller delivery in on off stump, and Kevin Wickham leans forward to dead-bat it toward the covers.
10.4: Taskin Ahmed tests the channel outside off, and Kevin Wickham prods forward to tap it into the covers for a single.
10.5: Taskin Ahmed operates from round the wicket, getting this length ball to nip back and beat Amir Jangoo all ends up as he stays rooted in his crease.
10.6: Taskin Ahmed pitches it up outside off, and Amir Jangoo frees his arms to square drive it through point with immaculate timing for four.
11.1: Mehidy Hasan Miraz drops it back outside off, turning inward as Kevin Wickham hangs on the back foot to keep it out.
11.2: Mehidy Hasan Miraz darts one in quicker and flatter outside off, leaving Kevin Wickham completely beaten as he looks to defend.
11.3: Mehidy Hasan Miraz keeps his length tight on off, and Kevin Wickham plays it defensively back down the pitch.
11.4: Mehidy Hasan Miraz extracts turn from a back-of-a-length delivery, prompting Kevin Wickham to drop back and tuck it toward mid-wicket.
11.5: Mehidy Hasan Miraz drifts one into the leg stump from a back of a length, forcing Kevin Wickham to work it away toward backward square leg.
11.6: Mehidy Hasan Miraz drifts one straight through on off, catching Kevin Wickham's leading edge as he plays for turn, sending the ball through backward point for two runs.
12.1: Taskin Ahmed extracts late seam away from a back-of-a-length delivery, squaring up Amir Jangoo who edges it off the outer half past gully for a couple.
12.2: Taskin Ahmed digs it in on a hard length at 132.2kph, and Amir Jangoo camps back to push it toward mid-wicket on a sluggish surface.
12.3: Taskin Ahmed pitches it up at 132.4kph, shaping in sharply before Amir Jangoo drives firmly on the up towards mid-off.
12.4: Taskin Ahmed attacks the fifth stump channel on a hard length, and Jangoo retreats to punch the ball cleanly towards extra cover.
12.5: Taskin Ahmed oversteps on a back of a length delivery down leg, prompting a loud caught-behind appeal as Litton Das dives brilliantly to his right.
12.5: Taskin Ahmed bangs it back of a length on off stump, and Jangoo stays on the back foot to play a dead-bat defensive stroke.
12.6: Amir Jangoo finds the boundary off Taskin Ahmed for four.
23.2: Mehidy Hasan Miraz slides this length ball into off stump, allowing Amir Jangoo to create room and force a back-foot punch out to deep point for a single.
23.3: Mehidy Hasan Miraz attacks with a length delivery, and Kevin Wickham retreats deep into his crease to comfortably block it.
23.4: Mehidy Hasan Miraz tosses it up, inviting Kevin Wickham to skip down the track and drill his drive firmly down to long-on for a run.
23.5: Mehidy Hasan Miraz delivers a full ball on off, met promptly by Amir Jangoo on the front foot in a solid defensive stroke.
23.6: Mehidy Hasan Miraz extracts a hint of turn from a length delivery on off, prompting Amir Jangoo onto the back foot to punch it straight to point.
24.1: Taijul Islam floats this delivery just outside off, drawing Kevin Wickham forward to dead-bat it toward short extra cover.
24.2: Taijul Islam drifts one in to dip and grip away from off, catching the shoulder of Kevin Wickham's defensive blade as it trickles past the slips.
24.3: Taijul Islam keeps it tight as Kevin Wickham goes back in his crease to pat the ball gently into the short midwicket region.
24.4: Taijul Islam gets one to skid and stay low on a good length outside off, but Kevin Wickham reacts quickly off the back foot to squeeze it to deep point.
24.5: Taijul Islam stays round the wicket to angle across the left-handed Amir Jangoo, who steps forward to smother the drift with a defensive bat.
24.6: Taijul Islam completes the over as Amir Jangoo comes forward once more to execute a watchful defensive stroke.
25.1: Taskin Ahmed clocks 127.5kph with a back-of-a-length delivery outside off, which Kevin Wickham meets softly from the crease to tap toward mid-off.
25.2: Taskin Ahmed digs it in short outside off, and Kevin Wickham expertly rolls his wrists over the extra bounce to jab it past gully for four.
25.3: Taskin Ahmed oversteps on a pitched-up delivery outside off, allowing Kevin Wickham to stride forward and punch it crisply through the covers for three runs.
25.3: Taskin Ahmed attacks the channel on a good length, prompting Amir Jangoo to step forward and calmly defend towards cover.

25.4: Taskin Ahmed targets the channel from round the wicket, clipping the back thigh of Amir Jangoo who hesitates between a shot and a leave, sparking a loud appeal that Bangladesh ultimately decides not to review.
25.5: Taskin Ahmed pitches it right up near half-volley length, and Amir Jangoo cleanly punches it past mid-on to collect a pair of runs.
25.6: Taskin Ahmed serves up another full delivery that Amir Jangoo punches straight to the fielder, bringing an immediate close to the opening session with lunch on the first day.
28.3: Taijul Islam lofts it full on off stump, inviting Amir Jangoo forward to smother the spin in defense.
28.4: Taijul Islam pulls his length back on off, allowing Amir Jangoo to camp deep and sweep it away toward sweeper cover for a single.
28.5: Taijul Islam drifts one slightly short outside off, prompting Kevin Wickham to hang back and punch with the spin straight to covers.
28.6: Taijul Islam offers room on a shorter length, and Kevin Wickham drops deep to time a punch through covers while a chasing fielder halts the ball near the boundary.
29.1: Taskin Ahmed digs it in short of a length outside off, where Amir Jangoo stays back to push a single towards squarish third man.
29.2: Taskin Ahmed hits a hard length on off stump, forcing Kevin Wickham back to dead-bat the ball toward short mid-wicket.
29.3: Taskin Ahmed angles a short-of-length delivery in from outside off, leaving Kevin Wickham to guard his stumps and let it pass.
29.4: Taskin Ahmed rattles Wickham with a 128.1kph bouncer outside off, zipping past his top-edge as the batter swings across the line.
29.5: Taskin Ahmed tests the sixth-stump channel on a shortish length, inducing a watchful leave from Kevin Wickham as the ball holds its line.
29.6: Taskin Ahmed feeds width on a short length, and Kevin Wickham pounces, rising over the bounce to drive crisply through covers for four.
30.1: Taijul Islam tosses it full on off, finding Amir Jangoo leaning forward to firmly dead-bat the ball.
30.2: Taijul Islam floats a slower ball back of a length on middle and leg, leaving Amir Jangoo to rock back and slice a cut through to deep cover for a couple.
30.3: Taijul Islam floats it back of a length on middle and off, and Amir Jangoo shuffles across to glance a single out toward deep mid-wicket.
30.4: Taijul Islam darts one in with the arm on a length, finding Kevin Wickham well-positioned to smother it neatly to the bowler's right.
30.5: Taijul Islam tosses this one up on off stump, inviting Kevin Wickham forward to stroke it firmly in the direction of mid-off.
30.6: Taijul Islam lands it on a length on off with a hint of turn away, catching the outer edge of Kevin Wickham's forward prod as it skitters toward short third.
31.1: Taskin Ahmed serves up a fuller length just outside off, prompting Kevin Wickham to lean forward and punch it sweetly on the rise to the covers.
31.2: Taskin Ahmed digs it in short on middle and off, forcing Kevin Wickham to raise his bat skyward like a periscope and duck safely beneath the bouncer.
31.3: Taskin Ahmed offers a fuller delivery outside off, and Kevin Wickham reaches out to steer his drive squarely toward cover-point.
31.4: Taskin Ahmed bangs it in hard on a demanding length, testing the batter's resolve.
46.2: Hasan Mahmud delivers a back-of-a-length ball at 128kph just outside off, and Kevin Wickham stays on the crease to block.
46.3: Hasan Mahmud pushes this delivery right up on off and middle at 133kph, allowing Wickham to mistime it off the inside half wide of mid-on for a single.
46.4: Hasan Mahmud digs it short to Amir Jangoo, who pulls early off the toe-end, prompting Mahmud to dive forward and get both hands to a tough chance that ultimately hits the turf.
46.5: Hasan Mahmud bowls a waist-high delivery that Wickham mistimes on the pull through midwicket, finding the gap and racing back for three runs.
46.6: Hasan Mahmud pitches up outside off and Amir Jangoo pushes the ball straight to cover.
47.1: Mehidy Hasan Miraz bowls and Kevin Wickham defends it straight down the pitch.
47.2: Mehidy Hasan Miraz induces a crisp back-foot punch from Wickham that prompts a diving, single-handed effort from Rahim at short extra cover, yielding two runs.
47.3: Mehidy Hasan Miraz spears a length ball into the stumps, forcing Wickham onto the back foot to defend.
47.4: Mehidy Hasan Miraz keeps it on a good length on leg stump, met securely by a defensive prod down the pitch from Wickham.
47.5: Mehidy Hasan Miraz drifts one slightly short into the pads, allowing Kevin Wickham to clip it smoothly away toward deep backward square for a single.
47.6: Mehidy Hasan Miraz attacks the pads on a good length, securely blocked away by Amir Jangoo.
48.1: Hasan Mahmud targets the body with a steep short delivery that strikes Wickham on the bottom glove, bringing the physio onto the field to strap an injured index finger.
48.2: Hasan Mahmud bangs it in short, and Kevin Wickham expertly dabs it wide of gully for a single.
48.3: Hasan Mahmud lands a probing length ball on the stumps, which Amir Jangoo solidly defends forward.
48.4: Hasan Mahmud tests the batsman with a sharp short ball, and Amir Jangoo mistimes his hook shot straight to backward square.
48.5: Hasan Mahmud fires another short delivery from round the wicket, forcing Amir Jangoo to duck beneath the line.
48.6: Hasan Mahmud stays short with the final delivery, prompting Amir Jangoo to duck and watch it sail through.
55.1: Taijul Islam floats it flat and good length on leg-stump, prompting Amir Jangoo onto the back foot to nudge it wide of backward square leg for a sharp single.
55.2: Taijul Islam attacks from round the wicket, tossing up a slower, full delivery outside off which Justin Greaves drives comfortably to sweeper cover.
55.3: Taijul Islam tosses one up on middle, drawing Amir Jangoo down the track to flick the ball straight into the hands of the mid-wicket fielder.
55.4: Taijul Islam drops it full on middle, and Amir Jangoo presses forward to turn the ball softly toward the left of mid-wicket.
55.5: Taijul Islam cleverly shortens his length as Amir Jangoo charges down the pitch, allowing the batter to adjust and flick it wide of Nayeem at short fine leg for two runs.
55.6: Taijul Islam strays down leg with a length delivery, and Amir Jangoo rocks back to pull it fine past Nayeem's desperate lunge for a boundary.
56.1: Taskin Ahmed bangs it in short of a length on middle, and Justin Greaves steps back on the crease to nudge it toward mid-wicket.
56.2: Taskin Ahmed angles a full delivery into off stump that nips back late, catching Justin Greaves's thick inside edge as he pokes forward, sending the ball through square leg.
56.3: Taskin Ahmed serves up a tempting half-volley, allowing Amir Jangoo to stride forward and unleash a pristine cover-drive that rockets to the boundary.
56.4: Taskin Ahmed delivers a short of length ball outside off, which Amir Jangoo punches off the back foot wide of cover for a single.
56.5: Taskin Ahmed attacks with a full delivery just outside off, met by a textbook forward defence from Justin Greaves straight to cover.
56.6: Taskin Ahmed pitches it full on off with a hint of inward movement, and Justin Greaves meets it with a rock-solid forward defensive stroke toward mid-off.
57.1: Taijul Islam floats it full, Amir Jangoo marches down the pitch and forces it straight into the turf, allowing Mehidy to scoop it up at extra-cover for an exuberant crowd celebration.
57.2: Taijul Islam bowls a down‑leg length delivery to Amir Jangoo, who attempts a paddle but misses.
57.3: Taijul Islam bowls a length delivery that turns into off; Amir Jangoo cuts it hard and straight to sweeper cover.
57.4: Taijul Islam bowls a good length outside off to Justin Greaves, who defends it on the back foot to backward point.
57.5: Taijul Islam bowls a good length outside off that turns away a touch; Justin Greaves punches it to sweeper cover.
57.6: Dot ball from Taijul Islam to Amir Jangoo.
62.3: Taijul loops it full to Justin Greaves, who stays inside his crease and pushes the defense toward short mid-wicket.
62.4: Taijul serves it full on off, allowing Justin Greaves to stride forward and stroke a clean drive out to long-off.
62.5: Amir Jangoo dances down the track to loft Taijul way over long-off, soaring into the crowd to seal a magnificent second Test century amidst joyous West Indian celebrations.
62.6: Taijul offers another full delivery turning into off, and Amir Jangoo steps forward to meet it with a solid defensive bat.
63.1: Mehidy Hasan Miraz drops it full on middle, prompting Justin Greaves forward to glance it toward silly mid-on.
63.2: Mehidy tosses it full on middle, where Justin Greaves pushes a drive sharply back toward the bowler who gets a hand to it.
63.3: Mehidy drifts one down leg on a good length, and Justin Greaves steps back to turn it wide of backward square leg for a single.
63.4: Mehidy angles a flat, low delivery outside off, which Amir Jangoo plays off the back foot straight to backward point.
63.5: Mehidy floats it full on middle, and Amir Jangoo leans into his forward defensive stroke toward short cover.
63.6: Mehidy lands it full on middle and leg, leaving Amir Jangoo to stride forward and block it safely back down the pitch.
64.1: Taijul fires a flat ball on a good length, and Justin Greaves moves back to tap it into the pitch.
64.2: Taijul slows up a fuller delivery on leg stump, allowing Justin Greaves to reach forward and ease it toward short mid-wicket.
64.3: Taijul Islam floats one in on a flat good length outside off, and Justin Greaves steps back to punch it firmly towards sweeper cover for a single.
64.4: Taijul Islam comes from round the wicket and tosses it full on leg and middle, prompting Amir Jangoo forward into a solid defensive block right back to the bowler.
64.5: Taijul Islam fires a length delivery on off stump, allowing Amir Jangoo to drop back and deftly turn it to the left of mid-wicket for a sharp single.
64.6: Taijul Islam keeps it flat and on a good length on middle, where Justin Greaves moves onto the back foot to punch the ball directly to extra-cover.
67.4: Mehidy Hasan Miraz delivers a quick, slightly shorter ball that Justin Greaves leans ahead and dead‑bats for no run.
67.5: Mehidy Hasan Miraz bowls a flighted delivery on a fuller length that Greaves nudges to mid‑wicket for a single.
67.6: Mehidy Hasan Miraz sends a flighted ball to Amir Jangoo, who dances down the track and hits a clear four over mid‑wicket.
68.1: Nayeem Hasan bowls a fuller length that turns in from off, which Greaves leans ahead and blocks toward mid‑wicket for no run.
68.2: Nayeem Hasan bowls a 86.1 kph full delivery outside off that Greaves taps toward point for no run.
68.3: Nayeem Hasan bowls a half‑volley outside off that Greaves drives through wide mid‑off for a sublime four.
68.4: Nayeem Hasan bowls a shorter ball on off that turns in, which Greaves works to deep square‑leg for a single.
68.5: Nayeem Hasan bowls a quicker, full ball on off that Amir Jangoo leans ahead and dead‑bats for no run.
68.6: Nayeem Hasan bowls a short ball on off that Jangoo cuts to sweeper cover for a single, retaining the strike.
69.1: Mehidy Hasan Miraz bowls a flighted ball on a fuller length that Amir Jangoo stays leg‑side of and eases to covers for no run.
69.2: Mehidy Hasan Miraz drops it short down leg, catching Amir Jangoo on the pads for a scampered leg bye as the hobbling batter is restricted to just one.
69.3: Mehidy Hasan Miraz serves it full on off-stump, and Justin Greaves simply pushes the ball right back to the bowler.
69.4: Mehidy Hasan Miraz delivers a short ball turning into middle and leg, allowing Justin Greaves to tuck it away into the deep.
69.5: Mehidy Hasan Miraz fires one short around leg-stump, and Amir Jangoo stays back to dead-bat it down the pitch.
69.6: Mehidy Hasan Miraz attacks the leg-stump line again, and Amir Jangoo mistimes a reverse sweep off his gloves toward short third for a single.
70.1: Hasan Mahmud targets the corridor from round the wicket, and Amir Jangoo watches it sail past outside off.
70.2: Amir Jangoo marches down the pitch to smother a back-of-a-length delivery from Hasan Mahmud straight into the covers.
70.3: Hasan Mahmud hits a hard length in the channel, but Amir Jangoo covers the line expertly to stonewall it.
70.4: Amir Jangoo miscues a 132.2kph rising short ball into the vacant mid-wicket pocket for a fortunate single.
70.5: Hasan Mahmud angles in from over the wicket, and Justin Greaves pushes the fuller delivery straight back at the bowler.
70.6: Justin Greaves meets a full delivery shaping into middle and leg, guiding it neatly toward mid-wicket.
71.1: Mehidy Hasan Miraz slides one in on a back of a length, forcing Amir Jangoo back into a watchful defense.
71.2: Amir Jangoo looks fully recovered as he rocks back to cut a quicker, flatter delivery from Mehidy Hasan Miraz to deep cover for a single.
71.3: Justin Greaves strides forward to dead-bat a regulation length delivery from Mehidy Hasan Miraz on off stump.
71.4: Justin Greaves works a full ball on middle and off sharply to the right of mid-on.
71.5: Justin Greaves camps back against a slow, turning delivery down leg, picking up three runs as Hasan Mahmud tumbles in pursuit.
71.6: Amir Jangoo uses the back of a length to chop a single away into the outfield.
81.5: Hasan Mahmud strikes with a vicious length ball that rears off the surface, catching Roston Chase's inside edge through to Litton Das for consecutive wickets.
81.6: Joshua Bishop immediately challenges an lbw verdict on a sharp seamer, and UltraEdge vindicates him with a clear deflection off the bat.
82.1: Taskin Ahmed enters the attack, feeding an angling back-of-a-length delivery that Justin Greaves nudges toward mid-on for a brisk single.
82.2: Taskin keeps it tight around off stump as Joshua Bishop gets behind the line to dead-bat it toward the covers.
82.3: Bishop flashes wildly at a sharp inward-shaper, surviving a thick inside edge that scuttles away through backward square leg.
82.4: Taskin oversteps while delivering a back-of-a-length ball that seams into middle and off, watchfully kept out by Greaves.
82.4: Taskin resumes with a legal delivery shaping into off stump, which Greaves leans forward to block toward the covers.
82.5: Greaves drills a short-of-length offering off the width outside off, finding the short cover fielder on the bounce.
82.6: Taskin finishes the over with a lovely curving delivery on off, met by a calm defensive stroke from Greaves towards cover-point.
83.1: Mahmud probes around the off-stump channel on a good length as Bishop hangs back to block solidly.
83.2: Bishop dances down the track for an aggressive lofted drive, only to be comprehensively beaten by a vicious jag-backer from Mahmud.
83.3: Bishop swivels brilliantly on a low-rising short ball from Mahmud, pulling it powerfully through mid-wicket to find the boundary fence.
83.4: Hasan Mahmud lands a 134.2kph hard length outside off, and Joshua Bishop stays back to dead-bat it toward the cover ring.
83.5: Mahmud pushes it fuller at 131.5kph swinging into middle and leg, prompting Bishop to drive on the up straight to mid-on.
83.6: Mahmud probes the sixth stump channel at 133.8kph, drawing a tentative lunge from Bishop who fishes fruitlessly into the empty air.
84.1: Taskin Ahmed angles a good length delivery inward on off stump, patted watchfully toward the covers.
84.2: Taskin attacks outside the off stump, allowing the watchful batter to comfortably offer no stroke.
92.3: Mehidy Hasan Miraz drops it on a length to straighten past the bat, leaving Jomel Warrican to open his stance and block solidly.
92.4: Mehidy Hasan Miraz serves another full delivery, and Jomel Warrican strides forward to defend it down once more.
92.5: Mehidy Hasan Miraz imparts sharp inward turn, forcing Jomel Warrican to drive the ball straight into the turf with a dead-bat defensive stroke.
92.6: Mehidy Hasan Miraz extracts extra bite and low bounce as Jomel Warrican angles his bat down to bunt it toward short midwicket.
93.1: Taskin Ahmed digs it short outside off, tempting Shamar Joseph into an ambitious square pull that sails harmlessly past empty air.
93.2: Taskin Ahmed slips in a clever slower ball that thuds into Shamar Joseph's front pad, but the steep leg-side angle saves the batter from any review drama.
93.3: Taskin Ahmed tests him with a shortish delivery, which Shamar Joseph successfully works off his waist into the on-side for a single.
93.4: Taskin Ahmed offers width and length, allowing Jomel Warrican to open the face late and steer it past gully to find the boundary rope.
93.5: Taskin Ahmed delivers on a short-of-length angle, leaving Jomel Warrican comfortable getting right behind the line to block into the off-side.
93.6: Taskin Ahmed digs it in short with a deep square leg in place, prompting Warrican to easily duck underneath the rising delivery as the lunch break on day two beckons.
94.1: Mehidy Hasan Miraz flights it full from around the wicket, and Shamar Joseph solidly gets behind the line to dead-bat it toward the off-side.
94.2: Mehidy Hasan Miraz loops up a full delivery, and Shamar Joseph bravely swats it against the spin into the gap for a boundary.
94.3: Mehidy Hasan Miraz drops one in, Shamar Joseph plays forward into empty air, and Bangladesh burn a review as ball-tracking confirms the angle takes it harmlessly past leg stump.
94.4: Mehidy Hasan Miraz keeps it honest with a flatter delivery around the stumps, and Shamar Joseph answers with a disciplined defensive prod.
94.5: Mehidy Hasan Miraz floats one right into the arc, and Shamar Joseph launches a colossal strike over wide long-on for six.
94.6: Mehidy Hasan Miraz traps Shamar Joseph on the crease, but DRS rescues the batter on height as they head to lunch with a smile.
98.6: Mehidy Hasan Miraz loops it wide of the crease, pitching full on middle as Jayden Seales strides forward to dead-bat it right back down the pitch.
99.1: Taskin Ahmed hits a short of length on off, allowing Jomel Warrican to step back and steer it cleanly into the vacant gap ahead of mid-on for a single.

99.2: Taskin Ahmed fires one down leg that Jayden Seales misses on the flick, bringing a grimace from Litton Das as the ball strikes his right fingertips off the thigh pad and forces the physio onto the turf.
99.3: Taskin Ahmed digs it short outside off, tempting Jomel Warrican into a slashed cut that falls safely short of deep backward point.
99.4: Taskin Ahmed angles a back of length delivery into off stump, forcing Jayden Seales to fall right behind the line and stonewall it safely.
99.5: Taskin Ahmed targets a full length on off, and Jayden Seales meets it with a straight bat, presenting the full face to push it toward mid-off.

99.6: Taskin Ahmed feeds a full length just outside off, pushed softly toward cover by Jayden Seales as Warrican survives a near-miss run-out scare when Rahim misses the direct hit at the striker's end.
100.1: Mehidy Hasan Miraz tosses it full and drifting on middle, catching Jayden Seales's thick inside edge as the ball scampers away to deep backward square-leg for a pair.
100.2: Mehidy Hasan Miraz flights it full on off stump, inviting Jayden Seales forward to dead-bat the ball comfortably back to the bowler.
100.3: Mehidy Hasan Miraz zips through a quicker delivery on a good length, where Jayden Seales drops onto his back foot to work it wide of mid-wicket for a comfortable run.
100.4: Mehidy Hasan Miraz floats up a slower ball on a good length outside off, and Jomel Warrican gets his front foot down to smother it back.
100.5: Mehidy Hasan Miraz loops a full delivery just outside off, prompting Jomel Warrican forward to defend it cleanly back to the bowler's left.
100.6: Mehidy Hasan Miraz drops one into the leg-stump channel, allowing Jomel Warrican to step back and glide it into the deep square-leg grass for a comfortable couple.
101.1: Taskin Ahmed digs it in short at the body, and Jayden Seales expertly swivels inside the line to glance it past the chasing fielder and race away to the fine-leg boundary.
101.2: Taskin Ahmed targets the middle stump with a sharp back-of-a-length delivery, met firmly on the back foot as Jayden Seales drops his hands to block it down.
101.3: Taskin Ahmed switches to over the wicket, landing a tidy length ball on leg and middle that Jayden Seales confidently pushes toward mid-on.
101.4: Taskin Ahmed rolls his fingers across a clever slower ball down the leg-side, eluding the swivelling bat of Jayden Seales and dying harmlessly before reaching Litton Das.
2.6: Jayden Seales leaps to snatch a stinging drive, grazing his fingertips as Tanzid Hasan Tamim collects three runs down the ground.
3.1: Shamar Joseph attacks the channel outside off, inviting Tanzid Hasan Tamim to watch it sail through to the keeper.
3.2: Shamar Joseph digs it in on a short of a length, allowing Tanzid Hasan Tamim to punch it solidly off the back foot toward point.
3.3: Shamar Joseph digs this short of a length into the middle, and Tanzid Hasan Tamim rides the back foot, guiding the thick outer edge straight to short cover.
3.4: Shamar Joseph angles one into the left-hander on a good length, guiding Tanzid Hasan Tamim back to nudge it toward mid-wicket.
3.5: Shamar Joseph catches Tanzid Hasan Tamim off guard with a surprise short ball that sharply strikes the right bicep.
3.6: Shamar Joseph hits a tight good length on off, met firmly by Tanzid Hasan Tamim striding forward to dead-bat it toward mid-off.
4.1: Jayden Seales probes outside off with a full delivery, left alone by Nayeem Hasan as it dies ahead of Amir Jangoo.
4.2: Jayden Seales strikes with a cleverly disguised short ball that catches Nayeem Hasan's glove, looping an easy catch safely into Brandon King's hands at first slip.
4.3: Jayden Seales extracts sharp seam movement to completely square up Najmul Hossain Shanto, rapping him high on the back thigh above the stumps.
4.4: Jayden Seales fires a sharp bouncer directly at the stumps, forcing Najmul Hossain Shanto to duck underneath it.
4.5: Jayden Seales delivers on a shortish length targeting the middle, prompting Najmul Hossain Shanto onto the back foot to block it firmly just right of short mid-wicket.
4.6: Jayden Seales spears a full delivery straight into the heart of the stumps, and Najmul Hossain Shanto meets it with a dead-straight bat, guiding it safely toward mid-on.
5.1: Shamar Joseph charges in from around the wicket at searing pace, angling a sharp delivery into the pads that Tanzid Hasan Tamim tucks away toward the leg side.
5.2: Shamar Joseph probes on a shorter length, zipping the ball past Tanzid Hasan Tamim as the batsman misses his flick and watches it narrowly clear the leg-stump.
5.3: Shamar Joseph attacks the middle-stump channel with a testing length, and Tanzid Hasan Tamim neatly gets his body behind the line to dead-bat it to mid-off.
5.4: Shamar Joseph extracts extra bounce with a venomous wobble-seam delivery outside off, leaving Tanzid Hasan Tamim swinging fruitlessly into empty air.
5.5: Shamar Joseph bangs it back of a length with steep bounce, but Tanzid Hasan Tamim matches the rising delivery with a textbook defensive block off the back foot.
14.1: Jayden Seales delivers a short-of-length ball, and Towhid Hridoy stabs it wide of cover to rotate the strike.
14.2: Jayden Seales runs in to Najmul Hossain Shanto, who gets solidly behind the line and drops it toward cover.
14.3: Jayden Seales attacks the crease with a sharp back-of-a-length delivery angled sharply in, forcing Najmul Hossain Shanto into an ungainly tuck toward mid-on as the ball rears off the pitch.
